editorial:
Imagine falling for the most beautiful girl in the room, only to find out her dad is basically the mob boss of the city. That is exactly what happens to Sasha in this wild ride. He has no idea who Leonid Ivanovich is at first, but once the truth comes out, he realizes he is dating the daughter of a man who could have him disappeared in a heartbeat. The vibe is a great mix of a romantic comedy and a crime flick, making you laugh while you wonder if the main guy will actually make it to the altar in one piece.

The chemistry between the leads is great and the pacing keeps you interested without feeling too slow. While some of the jokes are a bit predictable, the tension of Sasha trying to impress a scary Godfather makes it a fun watch. If you are looking for a lighthearted night in, you should definitely try streaming this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture quality. Or, if you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a solid move for a movie night with friends.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head during the wedding preparations when Sasha proves his loyalty and courage. Instead of running away from the danger, he handles the chaos with heart and honesty. Leonid eventually sees that Sasha truly loves Mira and isn't just some random kid. The Godfather gives his blessing, the bad guys are dealt with, and Sasha successfully keeps both his heart and his hands. It ends on a happy note with the couple finally getting together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves romantic comedies with a dangerous twist.
